description: This file contains utility functions for handling non-null GraphQL field configurations, including resolving database nullability, creating validation hooks, and asserting GraphQL non-null constraints.

methods.name: resolveDbNullable
methods.description: Determines if a database field is nullable based on validation and database configuration.

methods.name: makeValidateHook
methods.description: Creates a validation hook for a field, considering database nullability, validation rules, and hooks.

methods.name: assertReadIsNonNullAllowed
methods.description: Checks if GraphQL non-null read constraints are compatible with validation and database nullability settings.

methods.name: defaultIsRequired
methods.description: Sets default 'isRequired' UI configuration for a field based on provided settings.
